data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were $145.3m and reduced to $138.7m at 31 December 2022. The syndicate reports adverse claims activity on prior years (notably the 2020 year of account) attributable to a number of natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Ida, Laura and Storm Uri, primarily affecting the property reinsurance book. The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prioryear reserve movement figure; detailed prioryear development by gross amount is not provided in the movement notes and the published triangle was not available in a readily machineextractable gross prioryear movement format.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2020 underwriting year has closed with a loss of $0.8m, which represents a loss on capacity of 0.9% having experienced adverse claims activity attributable to a number of natural catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Ida, Laura and Storm Uri.
The claims ratio of syndicate 6107 has deteriorated to 53% in 2022 (2021: 47%) mostly due to increased claims on the property reinsurance book.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding (145.3) taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding, 2021 comparative). No explicit gross prioryear reserve movement (movement in prior years, gross) was provided in the notes; the technical reserves reconciliation shows total movement in gross claims (which includes current year movements) but not a separate 'movement in prior year claims' gross figure. The report references adverse prioryear development due to specific natural catastrophe events but does not quantify gross PYD. Gross premium mix percentages were presented as percentages of gross premiums earned (not written); amounts were approximated by applying those percentages to gross premiums written (80.4) - see note.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the technical provisions note (gives ultimate losses, paid claims and gross outstanding by underwriting year). The development percentages were provided but the cumulative development amounts by period were not provided in a readily extractable numeric grid for prioryear diagonal comparison; therefore detailed development rows have not been reconstructed here.
